les: Hoe jy weet energie is daar
kaps_punt: ons is bewus van energie om ons, soos beweging, hitte, lig, klank

items.bewering: Niks in jou huis begin vanself beweeg of werk nie.
items.bron: weet.co.za, 'Energie-oordrag' (energy is the capacity to do work or bring about change; without energy nothing could move or work); EIA, Forms of energy (motion energy). Read as: nothing starts moving or working without energy. Pets and fridges that 'start by themselves' still run on energy, so the absolute holds in the sense the block uses it.

items.bewering: Die bal op die gras lê doodstil totdat iemand hom skop.
items.bron: An everyday illustration, consistent with EIA, Forms of energy (a moving object has motion energy, which a kick gives it). Wind or a slope could also move a ball, but the sentence describes one ball and makes no general claim.

items.bewering: Energie is wat nodig is om iets te laat gebeur, beweeg of werk.
items.bron: weet.co.za, 'Energie-oordrag': 'Energie is die vermoë om werk te verrig of verandering teweeg te bring'; Britannica Dictionary, energy: the ability of something to be active or do work. A sound Grade 4 rendering of the standard definition.

items.bewering: Niemand kan energie sien, vashou of in jou hand uitgooi nie.
items.bron: Physics-education literature on energy as an abstract quantity, not a substance (Feynman's 'we have no knowledge of what energy is', quoted in phys-l archives; studies on the substance misconception, AMSER/IOP Spark). Note: light is itself a form of energy (EIA, radiant energy), so 'cannot see energy' is the usual teaching convention 'you see what energy does'. The lesson treats light consistently as a sign of energy, so it does not mislead.

items.bewering: Jy sien, voel of hoor wat energie doen, en so weet jy dit is daar.
items.blok: Sien, voel of hoor wat energie doen
items.bron: EIA, Forms of energy: motion, sound, radiant energy (light) and thermal energy are forms of energy, and they are what can be observed.

items.bewering: Iets wat beweeg, het energie.
items.blok: Sien, voel of hoor wat energie doen
items.bron: EIA, Forms of energy: 'Motion energy is energy stored in moving objects'; weet.co.za: 'enigiets wat beweeg, het kinetiese energie'.

items.bewering: Iets wat warm word, skyn of klank maak, het ook energie.
items.blok: Sien, voel of hoor wat energie doen
items.bron: EIA, Forms of energy: thermal energy (heat), radiant energy (visible light) and sound ('energy moving through substances in ... waves') are all forms of energy.

items.bewering: Beweging, hitte, lig en klank is die vier tekens waarna jy kan kyk.
items.blok: Sien, voel of hoor wat energie doen
items.bron: EIA, Forms of energy (motion, thermal, radiant/light and sound are each a form of energy). These are the four signs the lesson teaches; the sentence does not say no other sign exists. A learner may read 'die vier' as exhaustive, but it is not false.

items.bewering: Beweging: die wiel van 'n fiets draai, en 'n bal rol.
items.blok: Vier tekens van energie om jou
items.bron: EIA, Forms of energy: moving objects have motion energy.

items.bewering: Hitte: die kospot word warm, en jy voel die Son op jou arm.
items.blok: Vier tekens van energie om jou
items.bron: EIA, Forms of energy: thermal energy; radiant energy from the Sun, absorbed by the skin, is felt as warmth.

items.bewering: Lig: die lamp in die kamer skyn, en 'n kers se vlam brand.
items.blok: Vier tekens van energie om jou
items.bron: EIA, Forms of energy: visible light is radiant energy; a flame gives off heat and light (EIA: burning turns chemical energy into thermal energy).

items.bewering: Klank: die radio speel, en jy hoor jou eie stem.
items.blok: Vier tekens van energie om jou
items.bron: EIA, Forms of energy: 'Sound is energy moving through substances in longitudinal ... waves'.

items.bewering: Vryf jou twee hande vinnig teen mekaar en tel stadig tot by tien. Jou hande word warm, en jy voel dit in jou vel.
items.bron: STEM Learning (stem.org.uk) energy-transfer resource: muscles do work against the friction between your hands, and that work warms them; Save My Exams, Work done and friction (AQA GCSE).

items.bewering: Daar was niks warms in jou hande nie en geen vuur of verwarmer naby nie.
items.bron: Read as 'you were holding nothing warm', which is how the Afrikaans reads. Hands are already at skin temperature, but the sentence does not deny that; it rules out an outside source of heat, which is the point of the test.

items.bewering: Dit is dieselfde twee hande, en die enigste nuwe ding is dat jy hulle vryf.
items.bron: STEM Learning resource (work against friction warms the hands). Working muscles also give off a little heat, but the rubbing (friction) is the only change in the set-up, and it is the main cause of the warming.

items.bewering: Die beweging van jou hande het hitte geword. Energie verander so van die een soort in die ander.
items.bron: STEM Learning resource: friction transfers energy mechanically into a thermal store; weet.co.za: energy is changed from one form to another (law of conservation of energy). The mapping, motion turned into heat, holds.

items.bewering: Die hout op die stapel agter die huis doen niks nie. Dit hou sy energie vas totdat iemand dit in die vuur pak.
items.bron: EIA, Forms of energy: biomass is stored chemical energy, and chemical energy becomes thermal energy when wood is burned in a fireplace. The 'holds on to it' image fits energy as a store and does not say energy is a substance (block 1 says plainly that it cannot be held).

items.bewering: Die kos in jou kosblik doen ook niks totdat jy dit eet nie.
items.bron: EIA, Forms of energy (chemical energy is stored in biomass); abdnha.org Energy for Kids: the chemical energy stored in plants is released when they are eaten.

items.bewering: Iets waaruit ons energie kry, noem ons 'n bron.
items.bron: EIA, Sources of energy (energy sources are what we get usable energy from). The definition is consistent with the lesson's examples.

items.bewering: In hout, kos en 'n battery lê die energie gestoor en wag tot iemand dit nodig kry.
items.bron: EIA, Forms of energy: 'Batteries, biomass, petroleum, natural gas, and coal are examples of chemical energy' (stored energy).

items.bewering: Sulke bronne raak later leeg, want die hout brand op, en 'n battery raak pap.
items.bron: EIA, Forms of energy (stored chemical energy is converted when it is used: burning wood, discharging a battery); weet.co.za (energy is transferred or changed, not destroyed). 'Leeg' maps correctly onto the store having given its energy away. 'Sulke bronne' refers to stored sources (wood, food, battery), so it says nothing about the Sun.

items.bewering: Haal die batterye uit 'n flitslig en druk die knoppie, en niks gebeur nie. Sit dieselfde batterye terug en druk weer, en die flitslig skyn helder.
items.bron: EIA, Forms of energy: a battery stores chemical energy, and electrical energy is delivered by charged particles moving through a wire to the bulb.

items.bewering: Aan die flitslig, sy knoppie en sy lampie het niks verander nie. Die enigste verskil is die energie wat in die batterye gestoor lê.
items.bron: EIA, Forms of energy (batteries as stored chemical energy). The batteries also complete the circuit, but what decides between light and no light is the stored energy (flat batteries put back would also give nothing), so 'enigste' holds for the comparison the block sets up.

items.bewering: Voedsel: die kos op jou bord.
items.blok: Vyf plekke waar energie gestoor lê
items.bron: EIA, Forms of energy / Biomass (Energy Kids): food from plants and animals is biomass, stored chemical energy.

items.bewering: Hout: takke en stompe wat van 'n boom kom.
items.blok: Vyf plekke waar energie gestoor lê
items.bron: EIA, Biomass (Energy Kids): wood is biomass, a store of chemical energy.

items.bewering: Steenkool: harde swart klippe wat uit die grond kom.
items.blok: Vyf plekke waar energie gestoor lê
items.bron: Afrikaans Wikipedia, Steenkool: 'n harde, vaste, swart sedimentêre gesteente, with bruinkool (lignite, dark brown) treated as a separate category; USDA NAL vocabulary: coal is a combustible black or brownish-black rock; CSIR (McGill 2015): South African coal is bituminous, mined mostly in Mpumalanga. Checked because lignite is soft and brown, but in Afrikaans (as in Dutch and German) lignite is 'bruinkool' and is not covered by 'steenkool', so 'hard and black' is accurate for the word used.

items.bewering: Olieprodukte: petrol, diesel en paraffien uit ru-olie.
items.blok: Vyf plekke waar energie gestoor lê
items.bron: EIA, Refining crude oil, inputs and outputs: a barrel of crude yields motor gasoline, distillate fuel oil (diesel), kerosene-type jet fuel and kerosene (paraffin in South African usage; Britannica lists paraffin and paraffin oil as other names for kerosene).

items.bewering: Natuurlike gas: gas wat onder die grond uitkom en deur pype loop.
items.blok: Vyf plekke waar energie gestoor lê
items.bron: EIA, Natural gas explained: gas is found in rock underground, on land and under the ocean floor, 'generally flows easily up through wells to the surface', and is sent through pipelines (only a small amount moves as LNG). In South Africa it arrives by the 865 km ROMPCO pipeline from Mozambique (Business Day, 2022).

items.bewering: Vier van hierdie vyf bronne gee hulle energie af wanneer hulle brand. Uit die vlam kom die energie as hitte en as lig.
items.bron: EIA, Forms of energy: 'Chemical energy is converted to thermal energy when people burn wood ... or burn gasoline'; a flame gives off light as well. Wood, coal, oil products and natural gas are burned for their energy: four of the five.

items.bewering: Voedsel is die vyfde bron, en dit werk op 'n ander manier. Jou liggaam brand nie die kos nie, en tog kry dit die energie daaruit.
items.bron: Respiration vs combustion comparisons (Vedantu, Collegedunia): respiration is a controlled, enzyme-driven, stepwise oxidation at body temperature with no flame; combustion is an uncontrolled burn at high temperature. Everyday 'burn calories' is a figure of speech, and the lesson is right not to use it literally.

items.bewering: Jou liggaam gebruik daardie energie om te beweeg en om warm te bly.
items.bron: abdnha.org Energy for Kids: the stored chemical energy in food is released and used for heat and movement.

items.bewering: Die energie in kos en in hout kom eintlik van die Son af.
items.bron: EIA, Biomass (Energy Kids): plants capture sunlight through photosynthesis, so biomass (food, wood) is a store of solar energy; LibreTexts Chemistry: the energy in plants comes from the sun. The sentence does not say the other three sources lack a solar origin, so it sets up no false contrast.

items.bewering: Ru-olie is gewoonlik 'n donker vloeistof diep onder die grond.
items.bron: energyeducation.ca, Crude oil: colour ranges from nearly colourless to pitch black, most varieties black or dark; EIA, Oil and petroleum products explained: it lies in underground reservoirs. 'Gewoonlik' covers the exceptions.

items.bewering: Pompe bring dit deur lang pype na bo.
items.bron: PetroWiki (SPE), Artificial lift: most oil wells need artificial lift at some point, and rod pumping (the pump jack) is by far the most common method; industry figures (Hart Energy 2014; ADI Analytics) put over 90% of producing oil wells on artificial lift. Some wells flow on reservoir pressure alone and some use gas lift, but as a description of how oil reaches the surface, the sentence is true.

items.bewering: Petrol, diesel en paraffien word meestal uit hierdie een vloeistof gemaak.
items.bron: EIA, Refining crude oil, inputs and outputs (gasoline, distillate, kerosene from crude). 'Meestal' is right and needed for South Africa: Sasol makes part of the country's fuel from coal and gas (OECD country note: 36% of petrol and diesel in 2020; BusinessTech 2026: about a quarter of local demand), so most is still from crude oil, but not all.

items.bewering: Die brandstof vir vliegtuie en die was van baie kerse kom ook daaruit.
items.bron: EIA, Refining crude oil, inputs and outputs: kerosene-type jet fuel is about 10% of a refined barrel, and waxes are listed among refinery products; CandleScience, Paraffin wax: paraffin candle wax is refined from crude oil (from the dewaxing of lubricating-oil stocks). 'Baie kerse' rightly leaves room for soy, beeswax and other waxes.

items.bewering: Die bron lê dikwels ver van die plek waar die energie nodig is. Steenkool brand by 'n kragstasie ver van jou huis af.
items.blok: Van die bron tot waar dit nodig is
items.bron: Eskom, Coal fired power stations: Eskom's coal stations are clustered in Mpumalanga (Arnot, Duvha, Kendal, Kusile, Matla, Tutuka and others); Mpumalanga produces about 80% of the country's coal (Eskom heritage, Mpumalanga). For most learners in South Africa the station is far away.

items.bewering: Die kragstasie stuur die steenkool se energie deur lang drade na jou huis toe. Elektrisiteit is die manier waarop die energie deur daardie drade by jou lamp kom.
items.blok: Van die bron tot waar dit nodig is
items.bron: EIA, Forms of energy: electrical energy is delivered by charged particles that typically move through a wire; Eskom heritage pages (Tutuka feeding the 765 kV transmission system). The 'sends the coal's energy' chain leaves out the boiler, steam and turbine, but each link it does state is true, and a learner reasoning on from it is not led astray.

items.bewering: Nou skyn die lamp met energie wat in die steenkool gestoor was.
items.blok: Van die bron tot waar dit nodig is
items.bron: EIA, Forms of energy (coal is stored chemical energy); Stats SA / Ember / IEA data: coal generates most of South Africa's electricity, so a lamp on the grid runs mostly on coal energy.

items.bewering: Baie van Suid-Afrika se elektrisiteit word so met steenkool gemaak.
items.blok: Van die bron tot waar dit nodig is
items.bron: Wikipedia, Energy in South Africa / IEA data: coal about 81.8% of national generation in 2023; Energize (Ember tracker): 74% to 86% of the monthly mix in 2024-25; Stats SA, Electricity: coal use inching lower. 'Baie' is true and safely under the real share, and it will not go stale as the share falls.

items.bewering: Die kos in jou maag laat jou bene trap, en dan ry die fiets.
items.blok: Van die bron tot waar dit nodig is
items.bron: abdnha.org Energy for Kids (energy in food is released and used for movement); EIA, Forms of energy (chemical to motion energy). Taken literally, the stomach mostly prepares food and the energy reaches the muscles after digestion (Livestrong, digestion and exercise), but 'kos in jou maag' is ordinary Afrikaans for 'food you have eaten', and the chain food to legs to bicycle is correct.

items.bewering: Ons noem dit oordrag: die energie is nou op 'n ander plek as waar dit was.
items.blok: Van die bron tot waar dit nodig is
items.bron: Alloprof, Energy transfer and transformation: transfer is the movement of energy from one place to another, and transformation is a change of form. The lesson keeps the two apart (transformation in 'Vryf jou hande teen mekaar', transfer here).

items.bewering: energie: Wat nodig is om iets te laat gebeur, beweeg of werk.
items.bron: weet.co.za, 'Energie-oordrag' (the capacity to do work or bring about change); Britannica Dictionary, energy. Read on its own the entry is accurate for Grade 4.

items.bewering: bron: Iets waaruit ons energie kry, soos kos, hout of 'n battery.
items.bron: EIA, Sources of energy and Forms of energy (biomass and batteries hold usable energy). Accurate on its own.

items.bewering: gestoor: Iets wat vasgehou word en wag tot iemand dit gebruik.
items.bron: The general meaning of 'stoor' (to keep in store for later use), as in EIA's 'energy stored' for chemical energy. Accurate on its own; it makes no claim about energy in particular.

items.bewering: steenkool: 'n Harde swart klip wat uit die grond kom en baie warm brand.
items.bron: Afrikaans Wikipedia, Steenkool ('n harde, vaste, swart sedimentêre gesteente; bruinkool separate); USDA NAL: coal is a readily combustible rock; Dutch sources: bruinkool gives about a third of the heat of steenkool, so steenkool is the hot-burning kind. Accurate on its own, for the Afrikaans word.

items.bewering: ru-olie: Meestal 'n donker vloeistof wat onder die grond opgepomp word.
items.bron: energyeducation.ca, Crude oil (mostly black or dark, sometimes light); PetroWiki, Artificial lift (most oil wells are pumped). 'Meestal' covers both the light-coloured crudes and the wells that flow naturally. 'Onder die grond' includes oil under the sea floor. Accurate on its own.

items.bewering: olieprodukte: Al die dinge wat mense uit ru-olie maak.
items.bron: EIA, Oil and petroleum products explained: petroleum products are made from crude oil at refineries, including fuels and feedstocks for chemicals and plastics. Accurate on its own.

items.bewering: natuurlike gas: Gas wat onder die grond uitkom en deur pype loop.
items.bron: EIA, Natural gas explained (found underground on land and under the ocean floor, flows up wells, sent through pipelines). Accurate on its own. It does not say the gas is a fuel, but that is carried by the list block, and the entry is not false.

items.bewering: paraffien: 'n Dun olie wat mense in lampe en stofies brand.
items.bron: Britannica facts, kerosene (also known as paraffin, paraffin oil); dictionary sources: a thin, light oil from petroleum used in lamps, heaters and stoves; ASSAf No Paraffin! campaign and DMRE fuel-price notices: 'illuminating paraffin' is used for lighting and cooking in South African homes. In South African usage paraffin is the liquid, not the wax, and the entry uses it that way.

items.bewering: elektrisiteit: Die manier waarop energie meestal deur drade loop tot waar dit nodig is.
items.bron: EIA, Forms of energy: 'Electrical energy is delivered by tiny, charged particles, called electrons, that typically move through a wire.' 'Meestal' rightly leaves room for lightning and static. Accurate on its own as a Grade 4 functional definition.

opsomming: All 51 checkable claims hold, including every 'enigste', 'niks' and 'niemand' and all five comparisons; the one worth a person's glance is 'steenkool' as hard and black, which is right for the Afrikaans word because lignite is the separate 'bruinkool'.
